wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The article explains the Molech/Moloch spelling variant and quotes 2 Kings 23:10 directly. It also records scholarly disagreement over whether the term denotes a deity or a sacrificial rite/title. Link only as a related article and retain that uncertainty instead of asserting a settled deity identity.
